title: Instagram Stories (Instagram Graph API publishing)
description: Story videos published through the Instagram Graph API. Same encoding rules as Reels, with Meta's shorter duration, smaller file size and slightly narrower aspect-ratio range for Stories.

sources.title: Meta for Developers: Instagram Platform, IG User Media reference, Story video specifications

notes: Stories longer than 60 seconds are rejected by the API; split them into several stories.
Meta lists the audio bitrate as '128kbps' without saying whether it is a ceiling or a target. This profile treats it as a ceiling (with 2 kbps of slack for AAC overshoot) and only warns.
